hero.heading: Build the systems, not just the sprints.
hero.lede: We stay small enough that everyone still ships code or sits in client calls — including leadership. If you want ownership over real systems, not just tickets, this is that kind of team.

seo.description: Open roles at DivSphere in Karachi — engineering, cloud, data and AI, design, QA, and IT support. Small team, real ownership, working software every sprint.
